title: server side rendering
body:
I have no experience with server side rendering so I dunno what are the APIs available when you are doing pure react.

Here we have JavaScript wrappers bound to a helper, I wonder if we should and could propose some server side rendering utilities.

There seems to be two usecases:

* SEO, that's an easy one, you just get all the rendered html from the widgets and build a webpage out of it
* performance, sending a server-side rendered page that will be reused by us. But I am unsure that we can do this since we are wrapping react
